text:
Priya R.: Quick sync — postmortem follow-ups from INC-901. Need owners + due dates before Friday cutover. Proposed list:
```
ACTION-1: Investigate retry storm on job-dispatcher -> proposed: Tom L. -> due: Wed 09:00 PT
ACTION-2: Backfill missing embeddings from 2026-03-10 window -> proposed: Alex K. -> due: Thu 18:00 PT (depends on migration PR)
ACTION-3: Harden rate-limit config for internal ingest -> proposed: Maya S. -> due: Thu 12:00 PT
ACTION-4: Update runbook w/ rollback steps -> proposed: Priya R. -> due: Fri 08:00 PT
``` 
Please ack or propose changes. @Tom L. @Maya S. @Alex K. @Sam (Product)

Tom L.: Ack. I can own ACTION-1 but want to hand off the config patch to eng-infra if needed. Do we have logs for the storm window?

Maya S.: @Tom L. I can help with the config patch. Logs: linked in the incident doc — https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-901/logs (see dispatcher 03:14-03:22). I can take ACTION-3 and shift due to Thu 16:00 PT if that gives ops time.

Alex K.: I can take ACTION-2 but blocked by migration PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/452. CI flakes atm; ETA for PR fix ~6 hours. If CI stabilizes I can finish backfill by Thu 20:00 PT, otherwise Fri morning.

Sam (Product): Priority is ACTION-2 > ACTION-1 > ACTION-3. If backfill slips past Fri morning we need a customer comms plan. @Priya R. can you prep the comms draft if Alex flags delay?

Priya R.: Yep — I'll draft comms if needed. Small ask: @Tom L. can you add expected rollback criteria to the runbook snippet? Put it under 'rollback_conditions' in the YAML.

Tom L.: Will do. Patch incoming shortly. Example snippet:
```
rollback_conditions:
  - latency_p95 > 1200ms for 5m
  - error_rate_inference > 3% for 2m
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window conflict detected for Fri 08:00-09:00 PT. Noted.

Maya S.: Confirming ACTION-3 due Thu 16:00 PT.

Alex K.: Marking ACTION-2 tentative Thu 20:00 PT, will update if PR blocks.

Tom L.: ACTION-1 booked — due Wed 09:00 PT. I'll ping eng-infra for config review.

Priya R.: Thanks all — summary:
```
ACTION-1 -> Tom L. -> Wed 09:00 PT
ACTION-2 -> Alex K. -> Thu 20:00 PT (tentative, depends on PR #452)
ACTION-3 -> Maya S. -> Thu 16:00 PT
ACTION-4 -> Priya R. -> Fri 08:00 PT
```
If anyone can't meet the due, flag here or DM. I'll update the incident tracker and close loop with product comms.
